lines.gurmukhi: ਅਉਖਧ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਮੂਲ ਮਨ ਏਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aukhadh ma(n)tr mool man ekai man bisvaas prabh dhaariaa ||
lines.translation: The Mul Mantra, the Root Mantra, is the only cure for the mind; I have installed faith in God in my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਰੇਨ ਬਾਂਛੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪੁਨਹ ਪੁਨਹ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੨॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: charan ren baa(n)chhai nit naanak punah punah balihaariaa ||2||16||
lines.translation: Nanak ever longs for the dust of the Lord's feet; again and again, he is a sacrifice to the Lord. ||2||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਲਾਗੋ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: meraa laago raam siu het ||
lines.translation: I have fallen in love with the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਜਿਨਿ ਦੁਖ ਕਾ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਕੇਤੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur meraa sadaa sahaaee jin dukh kaa kaatiaa ket ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: My True Guru is always my help and support; He has torn down the banner of pain. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸਗਲ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: haath dei raakhio apunaa kar birathaa sagal mitaaee ||
lines.translation: Giving me His hand, He has protected me as His own, and removed all my troubles.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਕਾਲੇ ਕੀਨੇ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਆਪਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ni(n)dak ke mukh kaale keene jan kaa aap sahaaee ||1||
lines.translation: He has blackened the faces of the slanderers, and He Himself has become the help and support of His humble servant. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਹੋਆ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saachaa saahib hoaa rakhavaalaa raakh leee ka(n)th laai ||
lines.translation: The True Lord and Master has become my Saviour; hugging me close in His embrace, He has saved me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਣੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: nirabhau bhae sadaa sukh maane naanak har gun gaai ||2||17||
lines.translation: Nanak has become fearless, and he enjoys eternal peace, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਿਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasiree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਉਖਧੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: aukhadh tero naam daiaal ||
lines.translation: Your Name is the medicine, O Merciful Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਆਤੁਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਤੂੰ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mohi aatur teree gat nahee jaanee too(n) aap karahi pratipaal ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I am so miserable, I do not know Your state; You Yourself cherish me, Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਭਾਉ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhaar anugrahu suaamee mere duteeaa bhaau nivaar ||
lines.translation: Take pity on me, O my Lord and Master, and remove the love of duality from within me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਆਵਹ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ba(n)dhan kaat lehu apune kar kabahoo na aavah haar ||1||
lines.translation: Break my bonds, and take me as Your own, so that I may never come to lose. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਇਆ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: teree saran paiaa hau jeevaa(n) too(n) sa(n)mrath purakh miharavaan ||
lines.translation: Seeking Your Sanctuary, I live, almighty and merciful Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਆਰਾਧੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥੨॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: aath pahar prabh kau aaraadhee naanak sad kurabaan ||2||18||
lines.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, I worship God; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||18||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Raag Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਾ ਹਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: haa haa prabh raakh lehu ||
lines.translation: O God, please save me!

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਤੇ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham te kichhoo na hoi mere svaamee kar kirapaa apunaa naam dehu ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: By myself, I cannot do anything, O my Lord and Master; by Your Grace, please bless me with Your Name. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: agan kuta(n)b saagar sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: Family and worldly affairs are an ocean of fire.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bharam moh agiaan a(n)dhaar ||1||
lines.translation: Through doubt, emotional attachment and ignorance, we are enveloped in darkness. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਸੂਖ ਦੂਖ ॥
lines.transliteration: ooch neech sookh dookh ||
lines.translation: High and low, pleasure and pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਾਪਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੂਖ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: dhraapas naahee trisanaa bhookh ||2||
lines.translation: Hunger and thirst are not satisfied. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਰਚਿ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਆਧਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: man baasanaa rach bikhai biaadh ||
lines.translation: The mind is engrossed in passion, and the disease of corruption.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਹਾ ਅਸਾਧ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch doot sa(n)g mahaa asaadh ||3||
lines.translation: The five thieves, the companions, are totally incorrigible. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜਹਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਧਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee jahaan praan dhan teraa ||
lines.translation: The beings and souls and wealth of the world are all Yours.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਨੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jaan sadaa har neraa ||4||1||19||
lines.translation: O Nanak, know that the Lord is always near at hand. ||4||1||19||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਰਾਖੈ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਆਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: deen darad nivaar thaakur raakhai jan kee aap ||
lines.translation: The Lord and Master destroys the pain of the poor; He preserves and protects the honor of His servants.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਰਣ ਤਾਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਬਿਆਪਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: taran taaran har nidh dookh na sakai biaap ||1||
lines.translation: The Lord is the ship to carry us across; He is the treasure of virtue - pain cannot touch Him. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਜਹੁ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)g bhajahu gupaal ||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate, vibrate upon the Lord of the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਇਹ ਜਤਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਕਲਿ ਕਾਲ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aan sa(n)jam kichh na soojhai ih jatan kaat kal kaal || rahaau ||
lines.translation: I cannot think of any other way; make this effort, and make it in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aad a(n)t daiaal pooran tis binaa nahee koi ||
lines.translation: In the beginning, and in the end, there is none other than the perfect, merciful Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran nivaar har jap simar suaamee soi ||2||
lines.translation: The cycle of birth and death is ended, chanting the Lord's Name, and remembering the Lord Master in meditation. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਕਥੈ ਸਾਸਤ ਭਗਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bed si(n)mrit kathai saasat bhagat karahi beechaar ||
lines.translation: The Vedas, the Simritees, the Shaastras and the Lord's devotees contemplate Him;

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: mukat paaeeai saadhasa(n)gat binas jaai a(n)dhaar ||3||
lines.translation: liberation is attained in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and the darkness of ignorance is dispelled. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਰਾਸਿ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਏਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal adhaar jan kaa raas poo(n)jee ek ||
lines.translation: The lotus feet of the Lord are the support of His humble servants. They are his only capital and investment.
